title: Design System: Harmonic
note: Regenerated 2026-07-15 from DESIGN.md — the 'Ledger' premium-SaaS redesign that replaced the retired 'Signal Console' (cyan/dark/flat) direction. Light is the canonical theme; canonical color values below are the light theme, with the dark override alongside.

indigo-accent.usage: The interface's only voice: primary action, active nav, selection, focus, chart series. ≤10% of any screen.

indigo-accent-hot.usage: Pressed state — darker in light, lighter in dark.

accent-tint.usage: Fill under active nav items and selected pills — never decoration.

canvas.usage: The page field cards float on.

raised.usage: Inset fills: count pills, hovers, segmented track, the finished panel.

faint.usage: Icon-only affordances and disabled text exclusively.

tool-teal.usage: Tool calls, branches, harness metadata. Distinct from the indigo accent — the accent is the interface's voice, teal belongs to the work.

display.purpose: Page-level headings and the wordmark. Space Grotesk 600 (700 for the wordmark). Rare and large.

title.purpose: Card/section headings and summary values. System sans 600.

body.purpose: Prompts, prose, UI copy; buttons/nav at 500–600. System sans. Prose caps at 75ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels: field labels and table headers (600), chips (500). The only uppercase in the system.

data.purpose: JetBrains Mono, data only: task ids, costs, harness/model names, branches, timestamps, log/event streams, chart figures.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Cards floating on the canvas (light). In dark, depth is a lightness step, not a shadow.

shadows.name: bar
shadows.purpose: Floating elements: save bar, dialogs, chart tooltip, toasts. In dark the token carries a 1px hairline ring so it still separates.

motion.name: ease-ledger
motion.purpose: All state transitions, dialog and toast entrances, 150ms; instant under prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview: Harmonic renders as a premium-SaaS operator console in the Stripe lane: white (or zinc-dark) cards floating on a quiet neutral field, order carried by typographic hierarchy and real depth rather than darkness or ornament. A quiet system sans carries the interface; Space Grotesk signs the wordmark, page titles, and dialog headlines; machine data — ids, commands, costs, models, streams — answers in JetBrains Mono. One indigo is the only voice the interface itself speaks; every other color belongs to the work (running, accepted, failed, tooling). The layout serves a side-monitor glance: a slim sidebar, a status strip, full-width working views, and a board readable in two seconds. Both themes are first-class — light is cool-neutral zinc with white cards and soft real shadows; dark is the same product on zinc surfaces where depth comes from lightness steps.
keyCharacteristics: Sans-forward UI with a Space Grotesk display face for the wordmark/titles and mono reserved for data; six roles, fixed rem scale
Cards on a field: tonal canvas, shadowed surfaces in light, lightness steps in dark, hairlines only for shared edges inside cards
One accent (indigo ≤10% of any screen); state colors mean states, as tinted pills
True dual theme: light canonical-neutral, zinc dark; every pair holds WCAG AA in both
Dense but breathable: 13.5px body, 1.5 line-height, 4/8/12/16/24 spacing rhythm

rules.name: The One Indigo Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on at most 10% of any screen: primary action, active nav, selection, focus, the chart. If indigo is decorating something, it is wrong.

rules.name: The State Speaks Rule
rules.body: Amber, green, red, and teal are forbidden outside their semantic meanings. A color the operator can't parse as a state is noise. (API-docs carve-out: HTTP verb/code pills reuse the tints as a redundant second cue to the always-shown text.)

rules.name: The Zinc Rule
rules.body: Neutrals carry no hue in either theme. If a gray looks blue, it's a regression; warmth or coolness may only come from the accent and the state vocabulary.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only where the operator reads machine data — ids, costs, models, branches, streams. UI chrome and prose never set in mono; a mono heading is a regression.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 body / 500 UI emphasis / 600 headings (700 for the wordmark only). If hierarchy needs more, fix the size or the color layer, not the weight.

rules.name: The Soft Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is real but quiet and theme-aware: soft shadows in light, lightness steps in dark. Never pair a border with a wide shadow (the ghost-card ban); never nest cards inside cards.

dos: Do hold the One Indigo Rule: indigo (#5851e0 / #7a74f0) only for primary action, active nav, selection, focus, and the chart series — ≤10% of any screen.
Do floor informational text at Muted (#5c5c66 light / #a6a6b0 dark); 4.5:1 is the contract, and design every change in both themes before shipping it.
Do build depth theme-appropriately: soft shadows in light, lightness steps in dark.
Do keep every number in tabular-nums, ids/costs/timestamps in the Data face, and cost floors honest (≥, unpriced, —).
Do give every interactive element default, hover, focus-visible, and disabled states, and every animation a reduced-motion alternative.
donts: Don't ship CI/CD console gloom: no wall-of-widgets, no log-soup without hierarchy; density must stay legible.
Don't ship chat-app cuteness: no agent avatars, no emoji status, no anthropomorphizing copy.
Don't ship kanban-tool sprawl: no swimlanes, label taxonomies, or settings creep on the board.
Don't pair a border with a wide shadow (ghost-card), tint the zinc neutrals toward any hue, use gradient text, glassmorphism, or side-stripe borders.
Don't use state colors decoratively, set UI chrome or prose in monospace (Mono Is Data Rule), nest cards inside cards, or fall back to a native alert() — failures surface in the designed toast.

Don't let indigo mean anything but the interface's voice — tooling metadata is teal, there is no generic info blue, and no second accent exists. Terminal cosplay (scanlines, glow, the retired Signal Console cyan) stays retired.
